newsitem.title: BELGIUM: World steel output up 6.8 percent yr/yr in April.
newsitem.headline: World steel output up 6.8 percent yr/yr in April.

text.p: World crude steel output jumped 6.8 percent year-on-year in April, helped by higher production figures in Asia, western Europe and South America, the International Iron and Steel Institute said on Wednesday.
Total crude steel production reported by 66 producing countries rose to 65.1 million tonnes from 60.9 million the same month last year.
Output continued to rise in Asia, up by 8.7 percent to 24.4 million tonnes. Production in China increased by 8.5 percent to 8.8 million tonnes.
Production in Western Europe was 9.4 percent higher at 15 million tonnes, with higher production figures reported in Germany, France, Britain and Italy.
Poland's steel output soared 19.6 percent to one million tonnes and the total in eastern Europe rose 7.6 percent to 2.8 million tonnes.
North American output was up 4.8 percent to 10.6 million tonnes and U.S. production rose 4.0 percent to 8.1 million tonnes.
Overall production in South America increased 12.0 percent to 3.1 million tonnes.
